# STLBuddy

> > STLBuddy is an AI-powered 3D model generator that converts text and images into printable 3D files (STL, OBJ, FBX, GLB formats).

STLBuddy provides both AI-generated and community-created 3D models optimized for 3D printing. The platform supports multiple export formats and offers flexible subscription plans with credit-based purchasing.

## Key Topics

- AI 3D model generation
- STL file format
- 3D printing
- Text-to-3D
- Image-to-3D
- OBJ export
- FBX export
- GLB export
- Printable models
- Star Wars characters
- Creative Commons licensing
- Subscription plans
- Credit packs
- Droid models
- Fan art models

## Getting Started

- [STLBuddy Home](https://stlbuddy.com): AI 3D model generator: text/image-to-3D with STL, OBJ, FBX, GLB export
- [Pricing Plans](https://stlbuddy.com/pricing): STLBuddy pricing plans, subscription options, and payment via Stripe
